title: Module-valued coefficient adjustment through an isomorphism
statement: Let e:X ≅ Y and g:Y → Z, q:X → Z satisfy e.hom g=q, with q proper. Given coefficient objects B on X and L on Y, two isomorphisms bL,v:e*L ≅ B, a push-pull isomorphism z:e*e* ≅ Id, and a trace Rg_*L → U followed by U → W, an automorphism of B compares the two explicit derived trace composites. The pull-push unit followed by Re_*bL gives the first coefficient identification. Interfaces: [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories].

source.place: Both diagonal triangle calculations and the actual inverse-projection counit.

proof.text: Inverse image along e is an equivalence. Its right adjoint direct image is consequently an equivalence. The adjunction unit followed by direct image of bL identifies L with Re_*B. Apply the derived trace adjustment to this comparison, v and z at L. The resulting equality is exactly the stated native module-valued formula.

theorem exists_moduleTraceAdjustment
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A]
    {X Y Z : Scheme.{u}} (e : X ≅ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z) (q : X ⟶ Z) [IsProper q]
    (w : e.hom ≫ g = q) (B : DerivedCategoryModule A X) (L : DerivedCategoryModule A Y)
    (bL v : (ordinaryFinitePullback A e.hom).obj L ≅ B)
    (z : ordinaryFinitePullback A e.hom ⋙ ordinaryFinitePushforward A e.hom ≅ 𝟭 _)
    {U W : DerivedCategoryModule A Z}
    (τ : (ordinaryFinitePushforward A g).obj L ⟶ U) (j : U ⟶ W) :
    ∃ a : B ≅ B,
      (rightDerivedLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) q).map a.hom ≫
        ((rightDerivedLowerShriekIsoRightDerivedLowerStar
            (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) q).hom.app B ≫
          (ordinaryFinitePushforward A q).map v.inv ≫
          (rightDerivedLowerStarCompOfEq (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) e.hom g q w).inv.app
            ((ordinaryFinitePullback A e.hom).obj L) ≫
          (ordinaryFinitePushforward A g).map (z.hom.app L) ≫ τ ≫ j) =
      (rightDerivedLowerShriekIsoRightDerivedLowerStar
          (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) q).hom.app B ≫
        ((rightDerivedLowerStarCongr (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) w).inv.app B ≫
          (rightDerivedLowerStarComp (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) e.hom g).inv.app B ≫
          (ordinaryFinitePushforward A g).map
            (asIso ((derivedUpperStarLowerStarAdjunction
                (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) e.hom).unit.app L) ≪≫
              (ordinaryFinitePushforward A e.hom).mapIso bL).inv ≫ τ) ≫ j
